scenes.say: You can self-host n8n with one Docker command.

scenes.title: From the n8n docs
scenes.code:
docker volume create n8n_data

docker run -it --rm --name n8n \
  -p 5678:5678 \
  -v n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n \
  docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n
scenes.say: Create a volume for your data, then run the official image on port five six seven eight.
scenes.caption: Official image, data in a volume

cards.title: Before you use it for clients

scenes.say: Before you run client workflows on it, put it behind HTTPS, set up backups, and keep it updated.
scenes.caption: HTTPS, backups, updates
